#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Live driver for the standard-mode HumanoidBench package task.

Use this single script for all service interaction so the episode record has an
explicit, reproducible controller. Calls advance time only through submit or
observe --seconds; observe without seconds is free.
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

OUT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

def connect():
    return Robot()

def save_observation(res, tag="latest"):
    folder = os.path.join(OUT, "observations")
    os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
    for name, frame in res.last.items():
        from PIL import Image
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(os.path.join(folder, f"{tag}_{name}.png"))
    with open(os.path.join(folder, f"{tag}_meta.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump(res.meta, f, indent=2)

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("init", help="save spec/status and take initial free observation")
    sub.add_parser("status")
    o = sub.add_parser("observe")
    o.add_argument("--seconds", type=float, default=0)
    o.add_argument("--tag", default="latest")
    s = sub.add_parser("submit")
    s.add_argument("actions", help="JSON list of normalized target rows, or @path")
    s.add_argument("--dt", type=float, default=0.02)
    s.add_argument("--interpolate", choices=["linear", "hold"], default="hold")
    s.add_argument("--cameras", nargs="*", default=["room_camera"])
    s.add_argument("--video", choices=["none", "frames", "mp4", "both"], default="none")
    s.add_argument("--tag", default="latest")
    args = p.parse_args()
    r = connect()
    if args.command == "init":
        with open(os.path.join(OUT, "spec.json"), "w") as f:
            json.dump(r.spec(), f, indent=2)
        with open(os.path.join(OUT, "status.json"), "w") as f:
            json.dump(r.status(), f, indent=2)
        res = r.get_obs(video="none")
        save_observation(res, "initial")
        print(json.dumps({"spec": r.spec(), "status": r.status(), "meta": res.meta}, indent=2))
    elif args.command == "status":
        print(json.dumps(r.status(), indent=2))
    elif args.command == "observe":
        res = r.get_obs(seconds=args.seconds, video="none")
        save_observation(res, args.tag)
        print(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
    elif args.command == "submit":
        raw = args.actions
        if raw.startswith("@"):
            with open(raw[1:]) as f:
                raw = f.read()
        actions = np.asarray(json.loads(raw), dtype=np.float32)
        if actions.ndim == 1:
            actions = actions[None, :]
        res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=args.dt,
                       interpolate=args.interpolate, cameras=args.cameras,
                       video=args.video, note=f"package driver: {args.tag}")
        save_observation(res, args.tag)
        print(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
